labelMapping: All 24 species collapsed to one class: colony
splitUnit: Entire bacterial species plus conservative pHash-neighbor connected components. Components too large for a15percent holdout go to training; seeded remaining components fill test/validation to15percent with at least3components each. Validation/test are unseen species; no near-similarity candidate crosses splits.
similarityCaveat: pHash candidates may be distinct colonies on similar round plates; grouping is conservative, not a claim they are duplicate photos.
